WITH statin_ingredients AS (
  SELECT concept_id
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Drug'
    AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
    AND standard_concept = 'S'
    AND concept_id IN (1545958,1592180,1549686,1592085,36852340,40165636,1551860,1510813,1539403)
), statin_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN statin_ingredients si ON si.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
), first_statin AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN statin_drugs sd ON sd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  GROUP BY de.person_id
), ck_30d AS (
  SELECT fs.person_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ck,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ck_gt_5x_uln
  FROM first_statin fs
  LEFT JOIN omop.measurement m
    ON m.person_id = fs.person_id
   AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3007220
   AND m.measurement_date >= fs.index_date
   AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 31, fs.index_date)
  GROUP BY fs.person_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_statin_users,
       SUM(has_ck) AS users_with_ck_measured_30d,
       SUM(ck_gt_5x_uln) AS users_with_ck_gt_5x_uln_30d,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(ck_gt_5x_uln) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS pct_of_all_new_users,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(ck_gt_5x_uln) / NULLIF(SUM(has_ck),0) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS pct_among_ck_tested
FROM ck_30d;
